facts.text: Arthur, the sea gave me you. Eat up, then go and get your kingdom.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Not a Tom Curry line. The only Tom lines on the Wikiquote page are 'Here, you feel them.' and 'That's my superpower.' No real line about eating or kingdoms. Tom did rescue Atlanna from the sea, so a note in his voice can say that.
facts.fix: Arthur, the sea sent your mum to my door, and you after her. Eat up, then go and claim your kingdom.
